lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are visible, arranged in approximately five vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The spatial arrangement forms a staggered grid with centroids roughly equidistant within the vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly higher pixel intensity are observable running dorso-ventrally, with the high-luminance blobs serving as focal nodes at the center-points of these vertical bands.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible on the upper third of the flank, defined by a linear highlight on the superior edge and a narrow gradient into shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, contrasting with the larger and more widely spaced spots found on the main torso region.
